datasetcode.sh: Unique code assigned to the created dataset.

append.sh: True to append to existing rows; false to truncate the dataset first.

compressed.sh: True when insert-data is gzip+base64; false when it is a JSON-escaped string.

insertdata.sh: The rows to insert, as a STRING: a JSON-escaped array-of-arrays when compressed is false, or gzipped-then-base64 when compressed is true.

dataset_code.sh: Code of the dataset the model is trained on.

properties.sh: Full model configuration and structured metadata (excluding bulky training artifacts); shape differs by model type (RFM, CLV, ABC, ...).

columns.sh: Column names associated with each prediction row.

info.description:
Graphite Note (graphite-note.com) no-code predictive analytics: the Dataset API (create/fill/complete datasets), the Prediction API (v1 alias-based, v2 column-based, and timeseries forecasting), the Model Results API (paginated result tables) and the Model Info API (model metadata for MLOps/auditing).

This definition was authored by Voxgig from Graphite Note's public developer documentation (docs.graphite-note.com, REST API section) — no first-party OpenAPI definition is published. Shapes mirror the documented examples exactly; replace with a first-party definition if one becomes available.

Rate limits: 10 requests/min per tenant, 200/min global; 429 on excess. Custom 44x business statuses: 441 plan limit, 442 email exists, 443 trial finished, 445 model creation limit.

servers.description: Production. The Bearer tenant token comes from the in-app Account Info page.
